title: Changing order around shared meaning
meaning: Practical adaptability meets a motive to organise things dependably and an emotional attachment to a custom whose meaning both people recognise.
text: In this pair’s Energy Field, the Wheel of Fortune in the physical position describes actions that change as circumstances turn. The Emperor in energy motivates you to give a shared activity a clear arrangement, define responsibilities and establish boundaries. The Hierophant in emotions brings a sense of belonging to a meaning or custom recognised by both people. A change of routine can therefore feel comfortable when the revised arrangement preserves something important in your shared life.

For example, a work timetable no longer allows you to meet over Sunday breakfast. You move the shared meal to another day, deciding beforehand who will prepare it and when you will sit down. **Our custom rests on its shared meaning, as well as on a particular day.** What supports you emotionally is the recognisable character of the occasion: two people are setting aside time to gather and feel connected through a familiar tradition.

An argument can arise when organisational clarity becomes a claim to establish the custom on behalf of both people. One considers the new timetable sensible, while the other has yet to feel its former significance. A carefully organised meal may then be experienced as an obligation. The Hierophant does not establish that a tradition is compulsory for everyone; emotional belonging does not follow automatically because the arrangements have been agreed on paper.
